name: Grilled Steak with Chips and Salad
steps: Preheat the oven to 220C (200C fan-forced). Scrub the potatoes and cut them into chips about 1 cm thick, skin on.
Toss the chips on a large baking tray with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and a good pinch of salt. Spread them in a single layer and bake for 30-35 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
While the chips cook, take the steaks out of the fridge so they lose their fridge chill. Rub them with a little olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat a chargrill pan or barbecue over high heat until smoking hot. Cook the steaks for 3-4 minutes each side for medium-rare, or longer to your liking.
Move the steaks to a warm plate, cover loosely with foil and rest for 5-10 minutes.
While the steaks rest, toss the salad leaves, cherry tomatoes, cucumber and red onion in a bowl. Dress with a squeeze of lemon, a drizzle of olive oil, salt and pepper.
Give the hot chips a final sprinkle of salt. Serve the steaks with the chips, salad and remaining lemon wedges.
